distribution.summary: 福建；广东；广西；湖南；江西；四川；云南；香港；台湾
distribution.narrative: Smith et al. (2020) records Fujian, Guangdong, Guangxi, Hunan, Jiangxi, Sichuan, Hong Kong and Taiwan. Beaver & Liu (2010) independently accepts Taiwan occurrence. Lau (2025) provides additional secondary checklist evidence for Hong Kong occurrence. Smith et al. (2022) confirms the previously synthesized areas and adds Yunnan, with locality evidence from Honghe and Wenshan.

host_note: No host is reported in the promoted Smith et al. (2020) or Smith et al. (2022) records. Beaver & Liu (2010) notes a strong preference for Lauraceae and additional Oriental records from Shorea, Lithocarpus and Leucaena, but these are not promoted as Taiwan/China hosts because the geographic association is not source-resolved.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Xyleborus glabratus Eichhoff, 1877.
